criteria.automated_scope: The four old effect/export owners are absent, canonical files and source-role catalog entries exist, scoped literal imports preserve site-to-runtime dependency direction and retained executable consumers have no stale effect imports. Maintained source closure tests reject missing or misclassified browser effects; this is the declared literal-import/source subset, not a complete computed-import analysis.

Current maintained cases collect descriptors with variants.attach frozen, reject malformed/missing/reversed/duplicate/wrapped inputs, preserve raw code/CSS data, execute closure-safe factory serialization and verify offline marker/duplicate contracts. Descriptor design and unautomated readability judgment remain review obligations.

Task-specific immutable e501da8 evidence checks exact Color code/CSS/control hashes and byte-equal old/new offline adapters applied to the same current base. Authored content/templates/engine/scenes/assets/integrations/configuration and base public script/CSS bytes match that baseline. Selected actual generation/packaging/preview source contracts and Basic verify maintained runtime and output semantics while producer/snapshot hashes may legitimately change. These local checks do not observe current hosted navigation or PR preview smoke; those remain an exact-source external gate.

criteria.intent: Ready-made quality tools cover active sources.
criteria.automated_scope: Maintained coverage and negative cases prove canonical effect selection, complete tracked import closure, omitted/ignored/duplicate/unparsed ESLint rejection, browser security scope, authored/generated CSS coverage and exact newly exposed projector complexity debt. Actual current-source lint/security run results and interpretation of free-tool/Sonar limits are separately reviewed; no scanner success is inferred from fixtures alone.

The current bounded style guard verifies its declared subset, R1 legacy entries are removed, source inventory/catalog/views and RI/CI coupling are current, and maintained profile cases retain complete test inventories and pass/skip accounting. Applicable CS01-CS10 rules outside the guard, remaining source-bound exceptions and follow-up R2-R6 tasks require substantive review.

The local policy maps all six accepted criteria to current measurable checks and explicit gates; current RI/profile routes and acceptance-runner regressions preserve honest pending state. The policy cannot observe an actual linked Draft PR, required independent review, current raw-head CI, checkbox mutations or follow-up issue decisions; record those live facts separately. Merge/stable staging/production are outside this implementation authorization.

SOURCE-REVIEW.description: Record substantive independent review of the exact issue56 candidate: explicit descriptor/source boundaries, applicable CS01-CS10 rules, immutable source/runtime parity, exact reviewed projector complexity debt, actual lint/security coverage and the source-grounded free-tool decision. Review rules outside the bounded guard and preserve broader R2-R6/fragment-flight scope. Identify reviewer role honestly; self-review cannot substitute for independent review.

CURRENT-CI.description: Record the applicable passing current raw-head Basic/targeted/navigation/acceptance/source-quality checks and normal CI-controlled PR preview smoke. Bind evidence to the exact candidate source/tree/artifact/variant and preview URL. Source fixtures and local dirty preparation cannot establish actual hosted smoke, source scanner results or another head’s CI. No stable staging or production activation is granted.

DELIVERY-LINKAGE.description: Verify one separate issue56-linked Draft PR with exact Refs commits, AC-to-check/run evidence and independent review; reconcile actual issue checkboxes against original intent and preserve pending criteria. Record the remaining R2-R6 work and existing owning phases. PR merge/deployment/issue closure remain separate observations; this policy does not supply them.
